title: Our Locations
description: Four waterfront locations across Seattle. Beach access, stunning views, and the perfect setting for hot-cold cycles.

items.name: Golden Gardens
items.address: South of the Bathhouse, just before the traffic circle
items.parking: Limited street parking along Seaview Ave NW. Public lot fills quickly on weekends. Arrive 15 minutes early.
items.getting_there: From downtown: Take the D Line bus to Golden Gardens Park. 5 minute walk to sauna location.

items.name: Alki Beach
items.address: On the boardwalk, slightly west of the Alki Beach Bathhouse
items.parking: Street parking on Alki Ave SW and Harbor Ave SW. Metered spots ($2/hr). Arrive 10-15 minutes early to find parking.
items.getting_there: Water taxi from downtown to West Seattle, then 10 minute walk. Or drive across West Seattle Bridge.

items.name: Old Stove (Ballard)
items.address: Old Stove's Gardens Location on NW 49th St. East side of the outdoor beer garden
items.parking: Free parking lot on-site. Plenty of space. Street parking also available on NW 49th St.
items.best_time: Evening sessions - enjoy a beer after
items.getting_there: 40 bus line stops 2 blocks away. Easy bike access via Burke-Gilman Trail nearby.

items.name: Leschi
items.address: Dockside on Lake Washington off Lakeside Avenue
items.parking: Public parking lot next to BluWater Bistro (free for 2 hours). Overflow parking on Lakeside Ave S.
items.getting_there: From downtown: Take bus 27 to Leschi. 3 minute walk to dock. Limited Uber/Lyft pickup area.
